# dispatcher

> An autonomous backlog dispatcher for agent-driven development: a long-running Claude Code session works a Linear (or GitHub Projects) board, handing each task to a developer agent, each finished pull request to a reviewer agent, and each conflicting PR to a cleaner agent; the owner orders the backlog, answers questions, and merges.

Pages written for AI agents (raw Markdown):

- [Setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/backside4charter/dispatcher/main/website/docs/ai/setup.md): install and configure the dispatcher in a repository, phase by phase, with the commands to run and what to ask the human for.
- [System breakdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/backside4charter/dispatcher/main/website/docs/ai/system.md): the complete technical description - board model, task lifecycle, the loop, workers, claims, identities, event channel, review sync, worktrees, CLI, configuration, credentials, platform setup facts, development.

Human-facing pages:

- [How it works](https://backside4charter.github.io/dispatcher/concepts/how-it-works)
- [The board](https://backside4charter.github.io/dispatcher/concepts/the-board)
- [Get started](https://backside4charter.github.io/dispatcher/getting-started/get-started)

Source: https://github.com/backside4charter/dispatcher
